key_boundaries: JO YOUNG WOON is the verified Latin-script artist name; no Chinese translation verified from a primary source.
2014 publication is supported by the official collaboration partner; 2013 creation appears in a reposted interview and remains separately attributed.
FINDING UNICORN develops and releases the IP with the artist; copyright ownership and license contract terms remain unknown.
Edition quantities are supply, not units sold. Regional distributor release dates are not global debut dates.
No audited annual IP revenue or unit-sales series obtained; reported historical milestones are not comparable to POP MART financial statements.
